title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E09 — Toxic Wrecks
As shipwrecks of World War II continue to erode in the sea, their toxic cargoes continue to pose a catastrophic threat; now, experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate and reveal the potential impact of these noxious underwater dangers.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E01 — Killer Rocks
Earth is hit by 100 tons of rock from space every day; most burn up in the atmosphere, but a single rock wiped out the dinosaurs.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E02 — Death Ray
When a massive star dies, it can direct a blast of radiation that could obliterate all life.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E03 — Cosmic Scrap
More than 100 million pieces of small space debris are floating around the Earth; a collision between two of these objects in low Earth orbit could be catastrophic.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E04 — Little Green Men
Aliens could be lethal killers who want to invade and plunder our world; a team of experts investigates extra-terrestrial beings and their threat to human life.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E05 — Dark Star
Until recently, black holes were only theoretical; scientists know that millions exist and some of them have the potential to be lethal to earth.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E06 — Big Sleep
Experts discuss the many possible ways that could spark the beginning of the end for the universe, including when and why it would happen.

title: Strip the Cosmos
description:
S01 E05 — Alien Worlds
Using CGI to strip apart bizarre planets and strange moons and peel away impenetrable atmospheres to uncover the secrets to extraterrestrial life.

title: Unearthed
description:
S07 E15 — Seven Wonders of the Silk Road
The Silk Road was the ancient trade route that connected Eastern and Western worlds. The road traveled through many countries and was a source of ancient mystery. Even today, the road is shrouded in mystery.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E01 — Pluto Under Pressure
Lost tapes show that Apollo astronauts heard unexplained transmissions on the far side of the moon; an amateur astronomer finds an odd disturbance in Martian atmosphere; an unidentified object in Earth orbit starts stalking Russian spacecraft.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E02 — Return of the Moon Bugs
Apollo 12 astronauts bring back something alive from the moon; NASA tracks an asteroid heading towards Earth but make an incredible discovery.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E04 — Aliens of the Microcosmos
The hidden kingdom of microscopic alien organisms shapes the universe as much as galaxies, stars, and planets; new discoveries reveal how bacteria, viruses and other microorganisms built life on Earth and influence humanity's future in the cosmos.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E11 — Mystery of Alien Worlds
An explosion in the discovery of exoplanets is challenging everything we know about our universe; experts use cutting-edge astronomy to investigate these mysterious alien worlds and how they defy the laws of physics.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E05 — Curse of the White Dwarf
White dwarfs are small, dead stars with a dangerous side, and they are capable of exploding into supernovas and destroying planets; new research suggests these mysterious phenomena may be the key to understanding the universe itself.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E02 — Cincinnati's Secret Caverns
Deep beneath the streets of Cincinnati lies a network of deserted tunnels and caverns that contain a remarkable history of the city's origins, and now, experts investigate to reveal who built this underground labyrinth and why it was abandoned.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E02 — Grand Canyon's Lost Treasure
Descending more than 200 feet beneath the Arizona bedrock lies the largest dry cave system in North America; experts explore this vast subterranean network to reveal the mysteries and undiscovered treasure that remain hidden within its walls.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E03 — Murder Raid Tunnels
Hidden beneath the town of Ramsgate, England, lies a hidden network of over three miles of air raid tunnels; experts investigate and uncover an extensive WWII bomb shelter that became a permanent refuge for many civilians after a devastating attack.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E01 — Hotel Bunker of the Apocalypse
The top-secret construction of a massive nuclear bunker remained concealed under a palatial West Virginia hotel for decades; experts reveal how this vast subterranean structure was one of the most closely guarded Cold War secrets in U.S. history.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E05 — Mystery of the Kentucky Cave
The longest known cave system in the world spans hundreds of miles beneath the hills of Kentucky, and containing prehistoric artifacts and ancient human remains, experts reveal a subterranean mystery that may have changed the course of U.S. history.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Noah's Ark: The Endless Quest
Explorers investigate the snow-covered Ararat Mountains for remains of Noah's Ark; two separate expeditions claim discoveries in different areas, fueling debates over the truth of the story.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
The Ten Plagues: A Greek Curse?
The ten plagues of Egypt are supposedly sent by God to convince Pharaoh to free the Israelites; some scientists link these events to a volcanic eruption or climate change; could these be natural occurrences or are they divine warnings?

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
The Incas: A Sudden Fall
In 1532, Spanish conquistadors encounter the advanced Inca Empire; despite their sophisticated infrastructure, the Inca falls within decades; the story of how a powerful empire is overtaken by a small group of conquistadors remains mysterious.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Ramses II: The Greatest Pharaoh
Rameses II led Egypt through a sixty-year golden age as a powerful pharaoh; despite his recorded achievements, researchers investigate lingering mysteries regarding his wife Nefertari and his death.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
El Dorado: Gold, Guns and Greed
El Dorado, the legendary city of gold, captivated Europeans in the 16th and 17th centuries, sparking endless quests for hidden treasures; fueled by greed, these expeditions led to the loss of countless lives.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Ancient Rome: Fall or Pushed?
The Roman Empire fell in the year 476, yet questions linger; did it truly fall or does it continue as the Byzantine Empire? What caused its demise? The debate remains controversial even among modern historians.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E05 — Mysterious Death of Jeffrey Epstein
Andrew investigates what really happened to Jeffrey Epstein; by reconstructing the crime scene using insider insights, expert analysis and a full replica of his jail cell, he tests whether the evidence points to suicide, murder or something darker.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E02 — Jersey Drone Panic
When a swarm of craft floods New Jersey's skies, panic erupts online; Andrew digs into every conspiracy theory, interviewing eyewitnesses and testing cutting-edge drone tech, until he uncovers the truth behind the incident.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E03 — Rise of the Ice Creatures
Neil Armstrong enters an unexplained spin; an Apollo 17 photo seems to show a US military outpost on the Moon; possible alien life swimming in the oceans of Jupiter's moons.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E04 — Ghosts on a Comet
When a Chinese moon rover breaks down, a scientist at NASA points to a mysterious material that seemed to sabotage the Apollo missions decades earlier; the Rosetta spacecraft discovers a comet that appears to be singing.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E07 — The Next Supernova
The galaxy is full of stars ready to explode into supernovas, a stellar detonation powerful enough to destroy all life on Earth; it's an event that hasn't occurred in 400 years, and the search is on to locate which star may be next.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S11 E05 — Solar System Special
Exploring new discoveries that rewrite the history of the solar system, revealing a complex and violent story that begins with the birth of the sun from the debris of a massive galactic collision to its eventual fate as a lone zombie star.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E01 — Inside the Terror Factory
Guided missiles, the Wasserfall, and the potentially war-changing V2 were dreamed up and tested in a base in Peenemünde.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E02 — Secret Nazi City
As the Nazis embark on their dominate rise to power, a massive construction project secretly begins across Eastern Germany; using the latest tech, experts uncover an elaborate network of underground tunnels and bunkers with frightening ambitions.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
Secrets of the Owl Mountains
Experts uncover a mysteriously abandoned underground complex that may have hid something very dark.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E03 — Underground Superweapons
A labyrinth of tunnels carved deep in the Polish mountains leads to the largest underground Nazi weapons development complex ever discovered.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E05 — Secret Relics of Nazi Research
The skeletal remains of strange structures are clues to a mysterious research installation secretly built by the Nazis in Western Poland; experts investigate and uncover top-secret military fuel development with a catastrophic purpose.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E06 — Mystery Beneath the Castle
When the Nazis took Ksiaz Castle in 1941, it wasn't for the view, and they got to work turning it into a fortress; secret staircases and elevators were built, while underneath, a vast network of tunnels was taking form.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:
S02 E07 — Secrets of Vogelsang Castle
A medieval castle-like complex in the remote mountains of Germany contains dark secrets to the Nazi's plan for world domination; experts investigate and uncover a nefarious training facility designed to groom elite Nazi personnel.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E06 — Village of the Damned
A forbidden island points to a strange South American town that locals claim was the home of Adolf Hitler; new data from NASA satellites might reveal a sunken lost continent in the Indian Ocean; a pit of bodies suggests fears of a zombie nightmare.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E07 — The Minotaur's Lair
A strange lake in Transylvania is the home of an abandoned village and a terrifying secret; when a labyrinth is discovered on an island once home to an ancient Greek civilization, experts investigate if it was the legendary home of the Minotaur.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E10 — Treasures of Valhalla
Evidence of human sacrifice for the Viking god Odin; shedding new light on Genghis Khan.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E09 — Finding King Arthur
An abandoned megacity in a remote jungle might be the home of an ancient treasure and a dark secret; when a mysterious circular stone structure is discovered in Scotland, experts investigate whether it's the fabled Round Table of King Arthur.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E12 — Temple of Blood
An ancient man-made volcano might reveal buried treasure and bloody human sacrifice; when NASA discovers a strange pattern in the Arctic ice, experts investigate if it has alien origins; a mystery in the Sahara might have a sinister explanation.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E08 — The Lost City of Goliath
A lost city near Jerusalem might have been the home of Goliath; bizarre underwater formations might point to a top-secret US weapons testing facility; a strange sighting in the Arctic could be a lost Nazi relic.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E05 — Swimming in Syrup
A classic physics problem is put to the test; the team tests two "magic bullet" theories.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E03 — Banana Slip, Double Dip
Adam and Jamie take on two classic comedy myths; Kari, Grant and Tory try to make homemade diamonds.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E04 — YouTube Special
The team tests YouTube myths; giant ball of Legos; the explosive power of match heads.

title: MythBusters
description:
S06 E11 — Coffin Punch
The whole team gets together to test myths about survival; in Coffin Punch, Kari, Tory and Grant test the silver screen saga; Adam and Jamie question what bullet-proof is.

title: Tomorrow's World Today
description:
S10 E06 — Science & Supplements
George sends Greg to the World of Innovation to explore how one company is transforming the supplement industry through traceability, science-backed formulations and rigorous clinical research.

title: How It's Made: Summer Editions
description:
Great Outdoors Special
How some outdoor essentials are made.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E09 — California Flood Fiasco
A perfect storm with tragic consequences strikes as floodwaters rip away a major highway crossing in Huron, Calif.; experts use the latest tech to investigate and reveal bridge scouring with unsupported concrete columns exposed for failure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E03 — Tower Crane Calamity
A crane collapse leaves seven dead on a holiday weekend in Manhattan; an investigation reveals how a shortcut taken while raising the crane left the machine swaying in the wind without proper lateral support.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E08 — Quake of Christchurch
Tragedy strikes the heart of a city as an earthquake wipes out a building full of people in Christchurch, New Zealand; experts investigate an inadequate structural design and weakness in critical supporting columns.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E01 — Pacific Coast Bridge Collapse
Residents along the Pacific Coast Highway are cut off from the outside world after a storm causes a bridge to buckle; experts reveal how the construction method of the old concrete bridge left it vulnerable to erosion on the steep coastline.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E02 — Island Observatory Failure
In Puerto Rico, an iconic observatory nestled into a giant crater has to close after cables holding up a critical platform come crashing down; experts analyze the cumulative effects that led to the collapse of this awe-inspiring structure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E04 — The Fern Hollow Fiasco
On a snowy morning in Pittsburgh, a messy commute becomes dangerous after a bridge collapses; an investigation reveals how corrosion and other environmental factors helped bring down this decades-old structure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E07 — Blaze of Winston-Salem
A catastrophic fire at a fertilizer plant threatens city-wide devastation in Winston-Salem, N.C.; experts use the latest science to investigate an outdated, wooden storage facility heavily stocked with volatile, explosive chemicals.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E06 — Nuclear Plant Disasters
Hunt for the root cause of atomic accidents; examine the Windscale fire, which led to safer reactor designs; learn why swift crisis management helped in the Three Mile Island incident; see why improper waste disposal fuelled the Kyshtym disaster.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E02 — Bridge Collapses
Bridge collapses have etched hard lessons into the history of engineering; Tacoma, Minneapolis, Genoa, symbols of innovation that have become stark reminders of what happens when flaws go unchecked.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E03 — Dam Collapses
When dams break, devastation follows; Derna, Malpasset, Brumadinho, three disasters that turned engineering failures into mass tragedies.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E05 — Skyscraper Collapses
Pinpoint the mistakes that cause major structural failures; explore the preventable explosion inside London's Ronan Point; the code violations that collapsed Lalita Park; the short circuit that set off a deadly fire in Tehran's Plasco Building.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E04 — Rollercoaster Accidents
Drill down on maintenance and safety lapses that derailed amusement park rides.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E01 — Plane Crashes
Look back at the Tenerife, Kegworth, and Paris Concorde air disasters; investigate the design defects that made these aircraft vulnerable; look at the role air traffic miscommunications played; relive the terrible moments before disaster struck.
